observations.body: Asking, seeking, knocking, parent-child examples, and the contrast between human and heavenly giving culminate in the Father giving the Holy Spirit to those who ask.
observations.label: Jesus speaks of the Father giving the Holy Spirit

observations.body: The passage presents Asking, seeking, and knocking as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Asking, seeking, and knocking

observations.body: The passage places The Father gives the Holy Spirit beside Asking, seeking, and knocking.

payload.posture: Read Luke 11:9–13 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states asking, seeking, knocking, parent-child examples, and the contrast between human and heavenly giving culminate in the Father giving the Holy Spirit to those who ask. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Jesus speaks of the Father giving the Holy Spirit
